research_question.proposed_value: How participants used supporting passages when reviewing assistant suggestions.

evidence.quote: We asked how participants used supporting passages when reviewing an assistant's suggestions.

method.proposed_value: Semi-structured interviews following a reading task.

evidence.quote: We conducted semi-structured interviews after a reading task.

findings.proposed_value: Eight participants reported checking supporting passages before accepting suggestions.

evidence.quote: Eight participants said they checked supporting passages before accepting suggestions.

limitations.proposed_value: Recruitment from one institution limits transferability.

evidence.quote: The sample came from one institution, which limits transferability.
